questions.name: Transaction Volume Over Time
questions.sql: select occurred_date as day, count(*) as transaction_count from marts.fct_transactions group by 1 order by 1

questions.name: Revenue by Merchant
questions.sql: select merchant_name, sum(amount) as revenue from marts.fct_transactions group by 1 order by revenue desc limit 15

questions.name: Revenue by Region
questions.sql: select region, sum(amount) as revenue from marts.fct_transactions group by 1 order by revenue desc

questions.name: Flagged Transaction Rate
questions.sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where fs.is_flagged) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) as flagged_rate_pct from marts.fct_transactions t left join marts.fct_fraud_scores fs on fs.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
